name: orbital
description: Orbital: a marketplace of intent-shaped Claude Code plugins. Skills are arranged in orbits around a shared core — formal-reasoning pipeline, architectural analysis, parallel orchestration, and developer utilities — each plugin answering one question about what invoking it does for you.

plugins.name: shifting
plugins.description: Formal logic reasoning pipeline: closed-world KB construction, proposition decomposition, model-based and Lean 4 proof verification, property instantiation as TDD tests, and proof-grounded specification realization.

plugins.name: scaffolding
plugins.description: C4 architectural modeling and Prolog-based codebase analysis with atomized phase skills.

plugins.name: trajectory
plugins.description: End-to-end orchestration of the shifting pipeline. Runs a single ticket through close-world → decompose-proposition → model-obligations → prove-invariants → instantiate-properties → realize-specification, finishing with explain. Renamed from `orchestrate`; the parallel multi-enhancement skill has been retired in favor of the single-ticket flow.

plugins.name: telemetry
plugins.description: Standalone developer utilities: logical commit generation, presentation creation, and bounded recurring loops.
